st.t: Enter the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild. A plain of mud sphere will teleport you inside the cave.
i: Food and potions to defeat 5 enemies without armour, weapons, or magic

st.t: Take off everything you're wearing, then drink the goblin potion. Confirm to become a goblin: your selection doesn't matter.

In the cave, go to the two goblin guards in the north-west. Go down the stairs they guard to the goblin temple, choosing Yes if asked. WARNING: don't equip your ring or ghostspeak amulet until you're in the crypt, or you will turn back into a human!
Enter the door to the crypt.
Equip your ring and ghostspeak item and talk to the ghost in the crypt.

Unequip all weapons and armour. The ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on, but you MUST unequip Morytania legs. Say Snothead's name at the south-west grave, then defeat him WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee. Pick up his bone from the ground before you fight the next priest.

With your gear still off, say Snailfeet's name at the south-east grave, then defeat him WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and range. Pick up his bone from the ground before you fight the next priest.

With your gear still off, say Mosschin's name at the north-west grave, then defeat him WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and magic. Pick up his bone from the ground before you fight the next priest.

With your gear still off, say Redeyes's name at the north-east grave, then defeat him WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and magic, and lowers your attack, strength, and defence. Pick up his bone from the ground before you fight the next priest.

With your gear still off, say Strongbones's name at the north grave, then defeat him WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using all 3 combat styles, lowers your attack, strength and defence. Ignore the level 29 Skoblins he spawns. Pick up his bone from the ground.

i: Food and potions to defeat 5 enemies without armour, weapons, or magic
r: Plain of mud sphere or charged Skills necklace

st.t: Take all five bones to Yu'Biusk. You must get there via fairy ring BLQ.
